extension.description: Development repository for The Crew side-project and refactor work. Contains dev/test builds that may change rapidly and are not intended for regular users.[CR][CR]Clean Kodi? Update repositories, then install bs4, SimpleJSON, and InputStream Helper from the built-in Kodi Add-on repository before module/plugin. ResolveURL comes from Gujal (bundled in this repo).
extension.disclaimer: This repository contains development software. Use at your own risk. Backup your Kodi data before installing.
